---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |> 
  group_by(playerID) |> 
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID)
  ) |> 
  slice_max(career_home_runs, n = 15) |> 
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |> 
  mutate(
    name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    span = paste(first_year, last_year, sep = "-")
  ) |> 
  select(name, career_home_runs, span)
```

```{r}
Batting |> 
  group_by(playerID) |> 
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID)
  ) |> 
  slice_max(career_home_runs, n = 15) |> 
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |> 
  mutate(
    name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Steroid Era",
      "Other Eras"
    )
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = career_home_runs,
    y = fct_reorder(name, career_home_runs),
    fill = steroid_era
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Career Home Run Leaders by Era",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Era",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |> 
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |> 
  group_by(yearID) |> 
  summarize(HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = HR)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds: Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```
